discovery_source: UNED official master catalogue enumerated at https://www.uned.es/universidad/inicio/estudios/masteres.html
notes: Direct AB match, fully online, official. Strongest UNED candidate for this profile. Fees/language/complementos de formacion NOT verified. All UNED official masters are DISTANCE/online, which removes the residency and relocation problem for a non-EU candidate, and UNED public fees are among the lowest in Spain - but fee figures were NOT captured in this pass and MUST be read from UNED's own tasas page, including any non-EU treatment. Formacion Permanente (titulo propio) catalogue: https://formacionpermanente.uned.es/tp_indice - ~950 entries, enumerated by keyword rather than exhaustively (GAP). Keyword sweep of that catalogue for music/sound/audio/event/festival returned NOTHING at master level (only short courses such as 'Psicologia de la Musica' and 'Psicologia y Musica'). UNED therefore has NO music-industry, events or sound-computing offering at any level in scope.
